propositions.canonicalProposition: Heating-element warranty claims on the fryer range fell from 38 per 1,000 installed units in 2021 to 17 per 1,000 in 2023, using the same claim definition, according to the warranty report supplied by the former employer's quality department.
propositions.rationale: The verification note records an employer-supplied report with a baseline year, comparison year and constant claim definition; the resume and reference check document the candidate's part in the corrective-action reviews.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the fryer range roadmap and wrote the high-efficiency fryer specification with engineering.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the roadmap and specification, and the work sample is an excerpt of the signed-off specification.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate visited 14 restaurant and catering kitchens to watch fryers in use and wrote up each visit.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the site visits directly.

expectedGap: Tender support covers technical sections and demonstrations; work on pricing or service-level terms is not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the warranty-claims result with its baseline year, comparison year and claim definition, as a result of the corrective actions the candidate took part in rather than the candidate's sole achievement; keep the documented roadmap, specification and site visits.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate contributed to pricing or service-level terms in the restaurant-chain tenders.
